2122120226342867237.en_summary: Japan's Q3 GDP contracted by 0.1% QoQ, a major surprise miss versus consensus forecast for 0.3% growth. El-Erian highlights greater focus on remaining data releases this week and the need for better economic policy alignment between the Ministry of Finance, Bank of Japan, and Prime Minister’s Office.
2122120226342867237.zh_summary: 日本第三季GDP季環比收縮0.1%，大幅低於市場預期的0.3%增長。El-Erian強調本週剩餘數據發布更受關注，並指出財政部、日本央行與首相辦公室之間需要更好的經濟政策協調。

2122119015619309943.en_summary: IEA sees tentative oil rebalancing while analysts see a “perfect storm” of oversupply. Spencer Dale notes more crude doesn't fix depleted inventories, refining shortages, or economic damage. The glut is largely a forecast; the constraints are real.
2122119015619309943.zh_summary: IEA看到石油暫時再平衡，但分析師認為存在供過於求的「完美風暴」。Spencer Dale提醒更多原油無法解決庫存耗盡、煉油短缺或經濟損害。過剩主要是預測；約束是真實的。

2122118953455726779.en_summary: Trump wants an overhaul of the U.S. air traffic control system after one router upgrade caused Friday's nationwide ground stop. FAA has already received $12.5 billion, and Trump wants $30 billion more. Hanke criticizes Washington’s solution to every failure as more money.
2122118953455726779.zh_summary: 特朗普希望全面改革美國空中交通管制系統，因一次路由器升級導致週五全國地面停止。FAA已獲得125億美元，特朗普還想要多300億美元。Hanke批評華盛頓對每次失敗的解決方案就是更多金錢。
